lines.quote: Designed and implemented the digital beamforming subsystem for a ground-based 12-element phased-array receiver at Hallaharju Space Systems. Real-time beam steering with per-element gain/phase correction.

Wrote all embedded DSP firmware in C++ for the processing board (Xilinx Zynq-7020 under FreeRTOS), handling time-domain beamforming, sidelobe weighting, and continuous calibration updates within a 2 ms frame budget.

I wrote the production data pipeline that ingests raw baseband samples from the receiver, applies calibration corrections, and produces beam-quality metrics that the operations team monitors in real time. The pipeline is roughly 8,000 lines of Python, runs as a systemd service on the receiver's host server, has unit tests and CI, and is maintained and used by three other engineers.

Responsible for RF test and calibration on Hallaharju's ground-based receiver hardware: antenna-pattern characterisation using near-field probe measurements, and S-parameter verification of the RF front end using an Agilent PNA-L network analyser.
